Hi Priyom,

Quick one from LaunchForge — we're designing a new cohort package for our Summer ’28 batch and evaluating vendor promos that can stack with a committed reserved offer. Two asks:

1) Can Redwood layer a short-term promo (starter credits + 10% discount on Dedicated conversion within 90 days) on top of a meeting-of-minds reserved commitment for 3 months?
2) Would you be open to a small, time-limited promo carveout that lets us apply unused cohort credits toward a Dedicated trial?

Attached is a rough spreadsheet of expected usage and a very early SOW so you can see the pattern. We care about predictable per-token economics for demo day (high throughput bursts) and a path to scale without a full commercial negotiation for each cohort.

Attachments: bespoke-bundle-draft.xlsx (xlsx), pilot-sow.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — if this is something you can do, want to loop in your pricing/ops lead and legal so we can get a sample quote and a short T&C addendum?

— Alyssa

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the details and the attachments, this is exactly the kind of cohort use we built the promo flow for. High level: yes, we can do a stacked pathway but there are a few guardrails we’ll need to set up so it’s operationally safe and doesn't create accounting revenue recognition headaches.

Quick notes:
- Promo stacking: we can apply a time-limited cohort credit on top of a reserved-demo commitment, but the cohort credits must be explicitly token-tagged and expire.
- Conversion to Dedicated: we typically allow a one-time credit portability window (30–90 days configurable) to seed a Dedicated trial. Beyond that, dedicated conversion discounts are handled as a separate commercial addendum.
- Legal: we’ll need a short addendum referencing credit portability and a clause for excess-burst billing.

I’ve looped in Marissa (pricing ops) and Ben (partner/credits) to scope a concrete sample quote + an ops playbook so you can see how it flows into billing. Marissa, Ben — can you review Alyssa’s attached usage table and put together: 1) a sample blended price for the cohort window, 2) proposed expiry/portability language, and 3) a one-slide ops runbook for our CS/billing teams?

I’ll keep the thread moving.

— Priyom
Priyom Das

Alyssa — reviewed the spreadsheet. A few operational constraints we should call out up front:

- Credit tagging: To port cohort credits to Dedicated we need a unique tag on the account and an exportable usage bucket. That means LaunchForge needs a manager account that we can map to the Dedicated trial.
- Expiry: For accounting simplicity we recommend a \"use-or-convert\" window of 60 days post-cohort; conversions after that require manual review.
- Burst caps: Demo day spikes will trigger burst billing if they exceed the reserved QPS; recommend we set a burst cap and pre-authorize a one-time overage.
- Audit trail: SF legal will want the audit trace for any credit transfers — Samir, could you confirm what your procurement team requires for the trail (email ok, or need signed SOW addendum)?

I’ll draft a short ops-runbook and attach the wording we normally use for the addendum. Attaching a quick sample clause in the drive link Priyom included.

— Marissa

Pricing & Programs, Redwood Inference

Alyssa — happy to propose terms. Based on the usage curve in the spreadsheet here’s a concise commercial option that should be easy to accept for cohort admins:

Option A (cohort starter + conversion window):
- 25,000 starter credits applied to cohort manager account (usable across seats, token-tagged)
- 15% discount on Dedicated conversion within 60 days capped at $5k total credit applied to invoice
- Demo day burst protection: 2x reserved QPS for a 4-hour demo window, additional throughput billed at standard overage rate
- Addendum: 60-day use-or-convert + audit trail requirement (email trails + CSV export)

We can flex the credit amount or discount if you want a stronger sweetener for the cohort. If that sounds good I can spin up a sample PO + an addendum template and share a DocuSign link for sign-off.

Attachment: sample-pricing-worksheet (generated) — I'll place final docs in the Drive link and share the DocuSign prep.

Thanks everyone — Option A looks sensible and is aligned with what our program director needs. Quick notes from our side:

- The 60-day portability window is acceptable.
- For audit trail: email trail + CSV export is fine; Samir, confirm if you want the addendum signed or the DocuSign PO alone will suffice.
- Please increase the demo day burst protection to 2.5x for the peak 2-hour slot (we expect a handful of demos that will be noisy). If that requires a small surcharge we can accept it.

Next steps for Redwood: share the PO + addendum in DocuSign and the ops runbook (one pager) so our ops can map the tag. We'll aim to sign by EOW.
